decision_question: Does the selected native queue API change this checked instrumented request/reply path on the same IDF kernel?
qualification_timing: Retrospective offline controls over existing qualification pilots; this new gate did not run during historical captures and authorizes only future exact-artifact comparisons.

timing_contracts.begin: Raw counter immediately before initiator request send after readiness checks
timing_contracts.end: Raw counter after checked reply receive; higher-priority worker phase bookkeeping can contribute
timing_contracts.units_and_clock: Gross HP SYSTIMER UNIT0 ticks, nominal16MHz from40MHz crystal; no independent frequency calibration
timing_contracts.aggregation: 1000 per-event observations per boot; nearest-rank boot quantiles, no independent-event inference
timing_contracts.observer_policy: No subtraction; separate counter-pair observer retained
timing_contracts.correctness: Capacity1 u32 sequence-XOR reply, ordered indices, declared phase and blocked-state checks, cleanup

timing_contracts.units_and_clock: Gross HP SYSTIMER UNIT0 nominal16MHz ticks
timing_contracts.observer_policy: Observed gross; never subtracted from message path
timing_contracts.correctness: No backsteps, raw52-bit width/range, configuration readback and bounded sleep/WFI checks

review.reviewer: independent source and adversarial review agents

limitations: These are retrospective retained pilots and offline controls, not a new physical run.
Review attribution and hashed documents do not establish semantic correctness, identity authenticity or human independence.
Supplied ELF/provenance and printed tokens do not cryptographically attest flashed firmware; retain flash verification.
Whole instrumented API paths with ordinary release placement, priorities1/5, radios not initialized; not kernel-switch cost, load capacity or power.
A changed ELF, provenance, configuration or endpoint map requires a new method revision and qualification evidence.
